veranderings.rede: After the comma the second clause stands on its own, so normal subject-verb order reads more naturally than carrying the inversion over.

veranderings.na: het 'n groot verskil aan die jag gemaak
veranderings.rede: Avoids a second 'baie' in the same sentence (and the fourth in the block) with an idiomatic phrase of the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Taai, sterk stringe in 'n dier se lyf wat spiere aan bene vasheg.
veranderings.na: Taai, sterk stringe wat in 'n dier se lyf spiere aan bene vasheg.
veranderings.rede: As written 'wat' sits directly after 'lyf' and can be read as referring to the body; moving it after 'stringe' makes the reference clear.
